t: This is 24 Heath Drive, a building in Camden. It was designed by C. H. B. Quennell, an English architect who lived from 1872 to 1935. He was also a designer, illustrator and historian. Heritage architect Cath Layton says his great influence can be felt in the houses and streets of London's suburbs and across the country. He also wrote books for children and young people, which an obituary said strongly stimulated interest in the cultural background of history.
